name: fld_prime_eq_sq_add_mul_add_sq_iff
statement: (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) : (∃ a b : ℕ, p = a ^ 2 + a * b + b ^ 2) ↔ p = 3 ∨ p % 3 = 1
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime), (∃ a b : ℕ, p = a ^ 2 + a * b + b ^ 2) ↔ p = 3 ∨ p % 3 = 1
informal: A prime is represented by the Eisenstein norm form a^2 + ab + b^2 (a, b ≥ 0) iff p = 3 or p ≡ 1 (mod 3) — (→) a^2 + ab + b^2 mod 3 is never 2; (←) 3 = 1 + 1 + 1, and for p ≡ 1 mod 3 write p = c^2 + 3d^2 (the a^2 + 3b^2 theorem), then with c > d: a = c - d, b = 2d, and with c < d use the equivalent form (d - c, c + d) after symmetry, checking nonnegativity.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → ((∃ a b, p = a ^ 2 + a * b + b ^ 2) ↔ p = 3 ∨ p % 3 = 1)
